prompt:

Asset type: wide 2:1 raster cover for the B1 Grammar test First and second conditionals.
Input image 1: edit target, the user's low-resolution cartoon thumbnail.
Primary request: faithfully redraw and improve the thumbnail with crisp high-resolution line art, readable typography and balanced padding.

Subjects: preserve the expressive young dark-haired cartoon man in a red shirt and tan trousers at left, looking right and gesturing with outstretched hands; preserve the stern balding moustached older cartoon man at right with crossed arms, dark shirt and light-gray trousers.
Composition/framing: two side-by-side character/quote groups, left quote above the young man and right quote above the older man; blue circular B1 badge in the upper-right corner. Wide landscape 2:1. Show complete characters and keep all words and badge inside comfortable margins.
Style/medium: polished flat editorial cartoon with expressive original proportions and clean black outlines.
Text left (verbatim): "If you do it again, I'll call the police!"
Text right (verbatim): "If I were you, I wouldn't do that"
Typography: bold friendly sans-serif, large readable warm-white text; highlight "If", "do", "call" in the left quote and "If I were", "wouldn't do" in the right quote in pale yellow. Render each quote exactly once with correct spelling and punctuation. Badge text: "B1" only, with decorative circular rings and no tiny writing.
Constraints: preserve original two characters, outfits, facial expressions, composition, charcoal palette and exact quotes; no new people, no extra slogans, no watermark or unrelated logos. No blur, overlapping text, clipped feet, hats or speech. Opaque background.
